hooks.command: dir=$(jq -r '.cwd // ""'); notify-send -a 'Claude Code' 'Claude Code' "Finished in ${dir##*/}"; bash "$HOME/.claude/hooks/speak-notify.sh" /usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/complete.oga "Finished in ${dir##*/}" &

json=$(cat); cwd=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); root=$(git -C "${cwd:-$PWD}" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "${cwd:-$PWD}"); name="${root##*/}"; q=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r '.tool_input.questions[0].question // "a question"'); msg="$name needs your input: $q"; notify-send -a 'Claude Code' 'Claude Code' "$msg"; bash "$HOME/.claude/hooks/speak-notify.sh" /usr/share/sounds/deepin/stereo/dialog-error.wav "$msg" &
